---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new PaperForge feature
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

Please describe the problem first, the proposed behavior second, and the impact on PaperForge's local-first and evidence-traceability constraints last.

## Problem

What user pain or workflow gap does this feature address? Why is the current behavior not enough?

## Use case

A concrete scenario where the feature would help.

## Current workaround

How do you handle this today, without the feature?

## Proposed behavior

What should PaperForge do?

## Impact on evidence traceability

How does this preserve or improve source-locator requirements and claim/evidence separation?

## Impact on local-first constraints

Does this keep PaperForge local-first? Does it avoid auto-uploading user data? Does it avoid weakening the Zotero read-only boundary?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered, and why you prefer the one above.
